profile.headline: System Administrator | Full-Stack Software Engineer | IT Consultant | Owner at JR ITSoftware Solutions, LLC
profile.jobTitle: System Administrator | Full-Stack Software Engineer | IT Consultant | Owner
profile.summary: I am a Marine Corps veteran with a passion for technology.  From working as a Collateral Duty Quality Assurance Representative, Safety Representative, and most recently at the United States Postal Service I have seen firsthand how technology impacts daily lives.  By turning daily tasks and routines into software programs, I have developed a passion to being a Full-Stack Software Engineer.  I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer & Information Technologies and my passion for technology led me to continue my learning by attending Code Platoon.  I look forward to creating software programs that can enrich your daily life and working with a company to achieve my career goals.

positions.title: System Administrator | Full-Stack Software Engineer | IT Consultant | Owner
positions.description:
▪ Develop responsive websites
▪ Perform Security Audits and Fix Vulnerabilities 
▪ Install and Maintain Networks (Routers and Switches) 
▪ Deploy and Upgrade Workstations 
▪ Manage users and computers
▪ Migrate users from GSuite to Office 365 and vice-versa
▪ Manage company and user's hosting 
▪ Manage Active Directory
▪ Custom software programming
▪ Linux server administration

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Code Platoon is a non-profit organization who helps military veterans and spouses to get a career in Software Development.  I am developing programs using  DJango, Python, Bootstrap, and React.

positions.title: Information Technology Internship
positions.description:
▪ Provided accurate and detailed documentation of problem, analysis and resolution actions performed during troubleshooting process.
▪ Prepared and imaged computers for OS and software upgrades. 
▪ Deployed software remotely using DSM. 
▪ Troubleshooted Patient Health Boards and deploy scripts. 
▪ Upgraded computer hardware to match company specifications 
▪ Configured BIOS settings to ensure computer security and recovery 
▪ Configured group policy settings with AES 256-bit encryption 
▪ Disassembled and imaged Dell computers for Windows 10 upgrade

positions.title: Postal Clerk
positions.description:
▪ Performed all of the following duties: loaded mail onto automated equipment, culling out unprocessable items; entered sort plan and started equipment; monitored flow of mail to ensure continuous feed; swept separated mail from bins/stackers; and stopped equipment when distribution run or operation is completed. Ran machine reports, cleared jams and contacted maintenance for assistance when required.
▪ In addition, provided service at public window for non-financial transactions; maintained records of mails; examined balances in advance deposit accounts; and recorded and billed mail requiring special service.
▪ Provided excellent customer service to customers
▪ Opened and managed satellite post office operations to ensure timely delivery of mail

positions.title: Safety
positions.description:
▪ Guided and trained plant personnel at locations with critical safety problems.
▪ Conducted and coordinated safety trainings and equipment certifications (i.e. Forklift, HAZCOM, Fall Protection, Scissor Lift ).
▪ Received injury claims by employees and directed them to appropriate services (Workers Comp/Manager).
▪ Ensured proper storage/disposal of chemicals and containers throughout production floor (Hazard Communication).
▪ Developed and maintained training of all employees through Alchemy system (Quality Assurance, Good Manufacturing Practices, and Human Resources Trainings).
▪ Evaluated hazardous areas and investigated risks.
▪ Documented and issued PPE to employees.
▪ Developed weekly tailgate trainings and ensured department compliance.
▪ Maintained InfoLink system to manage different variations of forklifts and forklift assignments.
▪ Ensured compliance with federal or local laws and regulations.
▪ Managed employee suggestion program.
▪ Ensured compliance of safety programs.

positions.title: Drill Instructor
positions.description:
▪ Maintained an effective safety program.
▪ Proficient in basic lifesaving methodology in order to effectively render medical assistance to resident as needed.
▪ Set the example regarding personal appearance, to include the wearing of prescribed uniforms and civilian clothing, for resident.
▪ Effectively communicated and interacted with supervisors, members of the general public, and other groups involved in the operation of the Judge Mario E. Ramirez, Jr. Juvenile Justice Center/Boot Camp Facility.
▪ Used independent judgment and discretion in supervising residents, including the handling of emergency situation, determining and deciding upon procedures to be implemented, setting priorities, maintaining standards, and resolving problems.
▪ Maintained the concept of managing a military style rehabilitation program.

company.name: Judge Mario E. Ramirez Junior Juvenile Justice Center Boot Camp Facility

positions.title: Collateral Duty Quality Assurance Representative
positions.description:
▪ Supervised maintenance on products enforcing proper use tools and publications decreasing product deficiencies.  Verified nitrogen and oxygen cylinders filled safely in oxygen clean environment
▪ Enforced safety/health regulations and policies reducing on the job mishaps
▪ Accounted for gear enforcing loss prevention 
▪ Performed product inspections expediting process using Green Belt Lean Six Sigma
▪ Calibrated products using multi-meters, gauges, torque wrenches within specifications
▪ Performed all tool and personal protective equipment inventories 
▪ Inspected tools for proper use 
▪ Inspected support equipment and machines for accident prevention devices
▪ Performed pre-operational inspections on support equipment and test sets
▪ Inspected buildings and facilities for fire prevention equipment and first aid kits
▪ Inspected facilities for emergency exits, updated emergency exit routes, and hazard signs
▪ Oversaw Support Equipment periodic maintenance implementing corrosion prevention techniques
▪ Verified all paperwork and made product ready for issue
▪ Inspected work center noise levels using decibel meter
▪ Inspected confined areas for gases using gas detectors
▪ Enforced proper use of personal protective equipment 
▪ Conducted broken tool/ missing tool and job mishap investigations
▪ Conducted oil spill cleanup procedures enforcing environmental hazard compliance
▪ Participated as member of technical task forces to investigate trouble areas and provided recommendations for corrective action.

positions.title: Work Center Supervisor
positions.description:
▪ Supervised 20 personnel enforcing accountability and training requirements met
▪ Directed meetings with production control and planned monthly work schedule and product inspections
▪ Enforced OSHA policies and regulations
▪ Managed training of personnel and taught new product procedures
▪ Enforced new product changes and complied with new procedures
▪ Verified changes to publications implementing all procedures necessary 
▪ Supervised building maintenance, safety, and cleanliness

positions.title: Production Control Chief
positions.description:
▪ Production Control Chief in CONUS and in Afghanistan 
▪ Verified all paperwork and issued gear
▪ Organized support equipment logs/records, verified up to date, and airspeed Maintenance Action Form cataloging
▪ Managed 20 personnel work center and reduced maintenance redundant tasks to keep it flowing effectively
▪ Directly supervised 2 personnel, administered military/job training, and motivated them to excel resulting in highest proficiency/conduct ratings
▪ Planned, scheduled, and coordinated gear inspections decreasing bottleneck by 25%
▪ Accounted and inventoried parts and product implementing loss prevention 
▪ Prepared lists of required tools, materials, and personnel to reduce time constraints delivering product in an expedited manner
▪ Prepared weekly/monthly production reports and reconciled with supply and logistics to expedite parts delivery
▪ Prepared purchase orders for tools, materials, and equipment 
▪ Expedited production operations implementing lean six sigma manufacturing procedures and cannibalized parts to get more equipment operational
▪ Experience with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access

positions.title: Technician
positions.description:
▪ Operated high pressure machines to wash and remove impurities from sidewalks, freezers, produce containers, buildings, metals.  
▪ Added specific amounts of chemicals to high pressure machines at required times to maintain solution levels and concentrations within marginal levels. 
▪ Drained, cleaned, and refilled machines or tanks at designated intervals, using cleaning solutions or water.  
▪ Measured tanks water levels using calibrated rods. 
▪ Inspected and detected machine malfunctions. 
▪ Set controls for water temperature, water pressure, and cycles.  
▪ Cleaned and lubricated machines using grease guns and hand tools.
